description: Free. Read the claim state of a Ni Biashara registry listing: has an agent (or a human owner, whose claim overrides) claimed this page? Pass the listing id and, for an agent claim, the payer wallet that claimed it. Returns the standing claim (page URL, readiness report, shelves config) or UNCLAIMED with the one-call claim path. Reading a claim is free; claiming costs $0.10 USDC over x402.

wallet.description: payer wallet that claimed the listing (optional; a human-approved claim reads without it)
